scope: Formula-provenance completion for canonical indicator families already present after terminal round 12.

trigger.observation: The first full-text census retained many article-level T0 candidate families whose source passages named a deterministic count, composition, or diversity indicator, but whose extraction fields remained generic placeholders because the formula neighborhood was not captured. Applying the final formula gate directly would conflate extraction non-recovery with absence of a reproducible source definition.
trigger.decision_timing: Frozen before candidate dimensions, local data correspondence adjudication, final hard-gate decisions, final feature counts, and all model outcomes.

does_not_reopen: Logical or physical search queries or Q/P.
Round-12 saturation endpoints or the decision that round 12 is terminal.

include_all_when: The family already exists in the H2-adjudicated terminal indicator library.
An outcome-blind inventory of frozen local inputs identifies a possible exact mathematical correspondence or deterministic derivation.
The family is within direct innovation, T0 substantive potential, T0 opportunity, or context-control scope.
The candidate correspondence does not rely on a desired feature or dimension count.
exclude_when: Only a similarly named but mathematically different local feature exists.
Required input is absent or only available after publication.
The only evidence is a review or a future outcome.
The family is selected only because it improves model performance.

source_completion_routes.description: Re-examine exact method, equation, table, or variable-definition neighborhoods in lawful English full text already frozen for an included source.
Acquire and hash lawful English open full text for an already included source whose H2 disposition was candidate_fulltext_missing or fulltext_unavailable.

When an included application explicitly attributes its formula to a cited foundational paper, acquire and hash that English primary/foundational source solely to authorize the existing family. This route cannot create a new family or change the search frame and is reported separately from saturation retrieval.

review_design.primary_ai: Creates an outcome-blind local-input correspondence inventory and a source-linked extraction draft.
review_design.H1: Independently verifies every proposed correspondence and extracts exact formula evidence without seeing primary or H2 decisions.
review_design.H2: Adjudicates all H1 proposals, including exclusions, source roles, construct equivalence, T0 boundary, formula fields, and research-team provenance.

formula_evidence_requirements: Exact canonical family already present before this amendment.
Original definition, original application, or mathematical foundation; a review cannot authorize a formula.
Exact page, equation, table, appendix, or section and a verifiable English evidence span.
Source-supported deterministic formula or algorithm, units, parameters, direction, required inputs, and maximum information time.
Source non-reporting of missing behavior remains 'Not reported' and is never rewritten as a source claim.
Research group is taken from author/affiliation evidence in the same frozen source.
H1 extraction and H2 approval are stored separately.

downstream_rule.operationalization: Only H2-approved formula-complete families proceed to the separately reviewed project-operationalization layer.
downstream_rule.data_audit: Every canonical family still receives an explicit local-data disposition, including no-match and construct-mismatch exclusions.
downstream_rule.dimensions: Candidate dimensions remain derived only after formula completion and indicator coding; no dimension is predeclared.
downstream_rule.selection: All original hard gates, redundancy rules, two-team dimension support, T0 restrictions, and outcome blindness remain unchanged.

reporting: Report this as targeted formula-provenance completion, not as search round 13.
Report the number of all families reviewed for local correspondence, the number sent to formula completion, and every inclusion/exclusion reason.
Separate already-included source evidence from cited-foundation supplements.
Retain the actual round-12 raw novelty counts and the owner-defined terminal stopping decision.
